Atman - The True Self - Story of Arunagirinathar
• Discover the Profound Wisdom of the Upanishads!**
Available in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam & Hindi
Select your preferred audio track from the settings menu!
In this enlightening episode of *Upanishad Ganga*, we delve into the concept of **Atman – The True Self**, through the transformative story of *Arunagirinathar*, a poet-saint whose life journey took him from indulgence and despair to self-realization and divine bliss.
What is **Atman**?
